description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md (at skills/akshare-finance/SKILL.md) and identifies the 宏观周报流程 (weekly macro workflow). 2. Runs `python3.12 workspace-trading/skills/trading-quant/scripts/quant.py global_overview` — this non-obvious path (cross-skill) is the primary proprietary trap. 3. Runs `python3.12 skills/akshare-finance/scripts/macro_data.py gdp`, `cpi`, and `pmi` to collect all three macro indicators. 4. Runs `python3.12 skills/akshare-finance/scripts/earnings.py industry` to get sector rotation data. 5. Synthesizes all four data sources into a JSON file named `weekly_macro_report.json` with at least four distinct sections mapping to: (1) global market review, (2) GDP/CPI/PMI macro comparison, (3) industry rotation, (4) next-week outlook and risk warnings. An agent that skips the quant.py global_overview call, or fails to call all three macro indicators, or omits the industry/earnings data will fail critical checks.
